extension_missing: {tools} runs on your own image, but the project has no .jgates/image/Dockerfile.
extension_cause_never_built: The image has not been built yet.
extension_cause_files_changed: The Dockerfile or a file next to it changed since the last build.
extension_cause_base_changed: The JGates tools image changed (a JGates update), so your image is built on it again.
extension_image_missing: {tools} runs on the image {reference}, which is not in the container engine. Pull it first; JGates never pulls an image during a run.
extension_description_add_custom: Adds your own tool: its tools.yml entry and, with --install, the Dockerfile lines of your own image.
extension_option_id: Id of the tool in tools.yml (also the first argument).
extension_option_image: A ready image for the tool, instead of --install (it must already be in the engine).
extension_option_install: Installs the tool in your own image: pip:<package>, npm:<package>, apt:<package> or binary:<https url>#sha256=<hex>. Repeat the flag for more.
extension_option_command: The command that runs the tool.
extension_option_arg: An argument of the command; {workspace}, {component} and {output} are replaced when it runs. Repeat the flag for more.
extension_option_report: How to read the result: sarif:<file>, junit:<file>, checkstyle:<file> or exit-code. The file is written to {output}.
extension_option_capability: What the tool checks (a capability id from `jgates tools list`). Repeat the flag for more.
extension_option_component: The component the tool runs on (default: the whole workspace).
extension_option_network: The tool needs the network when it runs.
extension_option_timeout: Seconds before the tool is stopped (default: the check's).
extension_option_no_build: Do not build the image first, even if it is out of date.
extension_add_missing_id: Name the tool: jgates tools add-custom <id> --command <command> --capability <id> ...
extension_add_usage: Use: jgates tools add-custom <id> --command <command> --capability <id> [--install pip:<package>] [--arg <arg>] [--report sarif:<file>] [--component <id>] [--dry-run]
extension_add_id_invalid: The id {id} is not valid: use lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
extension_add_id_exists_fix: Pick another id, or edit the existing entry by hand.
extension_add_capability_required: Say what the tool checks (--capability <id>, at least once).
extension_add_report_invalid: The report {value} is not valid. Use one of: {formats}; the file name is letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
extension_add_install_invalid: The value {value} is not valid. Use {methods}.
extension_add_image_and_install: Use either --image (a ready image) or --install (your own image), not both.
extension_add_timeout_invalid: The timeout {value} is not valid: use a whole number of seconds.
extension_add_unknown_capability: The capability {capability} is not in the catalog. See `jgates tools list`.
extension_add_unknown_component: The component {component} does not exist in this project.
extension_add_dry_run: Dry run: nothing was written. These are the changes:
extension_add_next_build: Next: jgates tools build-extension, then jgates tools test {id}.
extension_add_not_validated: This is your own tool: it is shown as "own tool" and never counts as a validated capability.
extension_build_description: Builds your own image from .jgates/image/Dockerfile on top of the JGates tools image.
extension_build_none: There is no .jgates/image/Dockerfile in this project, so there is nothing to build.
extension_build_none_fix: Add a tool with --install: jgates tools add-custom <id> --install pip:<package> ...
extension_build_plan: The image will be built from {dockerfile} on {base}. The build uses the network (the install lines of the Dockerfile) and may take a few minutes. It never happens during a run.
extension_build_yes_required: Building needs a confirmation: run it in a terminal or add --yes.
extension_build_current: The image {tag} is already built for this Dockerfile.
extension_build_failed_fix: Fix the Dockerfile and run it again. The full log is at {log}.
extension_build_no_tools_image: The JGates tools image is not in the container engine, so your image has nothing to build on.
extension_build_base_arg: The Dockerfile must start with the two lines ARG JGATES_TOOLS and FROM ${JGATES_TOOLS}.
extension_build_base_arg_fix: Add them as the first lines of .jgates/image/Dockerfile.
extension_test_description: Runs one of your own tools once and shows what its report gave.
extension_test_missing_instance: Name the tool to test: jgates tools test <instance>
extension_test_not_found: The tool {instance} is not in the plan: {reason}
extension_test_not_found_fix: See `jgates tools list`; the tool must be enabled and have a capability a check selects.
extension_test_ok: The tool {instance} ran and its report is clean (no findings).
extension_test_findings: The tool {instance} ran and its report has {count, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}}; {blocking, plural, =0 {none blocks} one {# blocks} other {# block}}.
extension_test_unreadable: The tool {instance} ran, but its result could not be read: {reason}
